description: This file defines the EndpointV2Middleware class responsible for handling endpoint rule evaluation, endpoint resolution, and authentication scheme application within the AWS SDK. It includes methods for resolving endpoint parameters, applying authentication schemes, and managing command context.

classes.name: EndpointV2Middleware
classes.description: Middleware class for AWS endpoint resolution and authentication scheme application.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that initializes EndpointV2Middleware with provided parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with handler, endpoint provider, API, args, and optional credential provider.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles command invocation, resolves endpoint, applies auth schemes, and proceeds with the next handler.

methods.name: resolveArgs
methods.description: Resolves and merges command, static, context, and endpoint provider parameters for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: filterEndpointCommandArgs
methods.description: Filters command arguments based on ruleset parameters for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: bindStaticContextParams
methods.description: Binds static context parameters to their values.

methods.name: bindContextParams
methods.description: Binds context parameters from command arguments.

methods.name: bindOperationContextParams
methods.description: Binds operation-specific context parameters using JSON path search.

methods.name: applyAuthScheme
methods.description: Applies the selected authentication scheme to the command context.

methods.name: resolveAuthScheme
methods.description: Selects the first valid auth scheme supported by the client.

methods.name: normalizeAuthScheme
methods.description: Normalizes auth scheme details to SDK-recognized keys.

methods.name: isValidAuthScheme
methods.description: Checks if an auth scheme name is valid and supported.

methods.name: resolveAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the AWS account ID from credentials if applicable.
